Rozpędź się i poderwij przód gazem z cia: Pick up speed, lift the front with the throttle and your body back, then keep the bike as close to the balance point as you can. The attempt starts when the front rises past {}°, and hops before that do not end the game. Your score is the distance on the back wheel. The attempt ends when the front touches the asphalt or the bike goes over backwards. Tail scrapes are allowed, but that stretch does not count towards the distance.
Na samym gazie przód tego motocykla ledw: On throttle alone the front of this bike barely lifts. Move your body back or pump the front: dab the rear brake, then open the throttle straight away.

Przesuń ciało do tyłu i otwórz gaz do ko: Move your body back and open the throttle all the way. As soon as the front starts to rise, begin closing the throttle, before it reaches the balance point. You can also pump the front: dab the rear brake, release it and open the throttle straight away.

Motocykl usiadł na ogonie i stracił pręd: The bike sat down on its tail and lost its speed. When the tail touches the asphalt, press the rear brake at once and move your body forward while you are still rolling. Braking pulls the front down and takes the bike off its tail.
